MPCE-E571 store_keys_wrong (store)
exit:     6
message:  the engine refused the store: it was written under another secret or digest key
next:     Nothing was read and nothing changed. Check the host's keys for this document: restore its own secret and digest key from where the store came from. Never make new keys for a store that has native records.
rule:     the MPCE seam (stable codes)
verbs:    a host call (no verb)
status:   live
